experiment.correctness: Check independent reference values and tie-aware index sets, end<k padding, invalid/empty rows, supported k boundaries, input/output strides and alignment, and sorted-index semantics where consumed. Compare eager and graph replay with changing end tensors and request membership; verify allocation stability and fallback behavior. Run a model-quality subset because selection ordering or ties can affect downstream attention. Acceptance rate is diagnostic, not correctness. Map to applicable G01-G05 once defined.
experiment.cost: Moderate-to-high integration uncertainty because the PR needs rebasing and extension build compatibility is unresolved. Cheap source/build inspection and operator screening precede serving confirmation. Use unknown eight-GPU hourly price P and measured T/N_output for parameterized cost; include any layout-copy or workspace cost. Exclude profiled runs from the serving frontier.

root_design.title: Native DeepSelect SM90 integration
root_design.source_observation: Current gate permits SM100. #59204 has applicable Python hunks; DeepSelect #14 supplies SM90 work. Native extension/CMake compatibility was not tested.
root_design.source_fix: Build and dispatch a supported SM90 FP32 selector with existing fallback and shape checks.
root_design.root_prediction: A faster selector may reduce indexer overhead for sufficiently wide eligible logits; current optimized top-k may already be competitive.
root_design.baseline_check: Pin/build native dependency, match FP32 logits, strides and row bounds, verify installed dispatcher and full-head kernel eligibility.
root_design.strongest_comparator: Current optimized vLLM top-k, not torch.topk alone; compare selector-only before adding page-mapping fusion.
root_design.activation: Native SM90 selections / eligible selector calls, with dimensions/dtype and fallback counts.
root_design.mechanism_diagnostic: Selection time, output conversion and total indexer span; hold logits and selected K constant.
root_design.reject_or_defer_if: Unsupported native build, different tie/causal semantics, no current-selector improvement, or small component gain with no service value.
root_design.correctness: FP32 edge cases, ties, short rows, strides, invalid rows, graph replay and deterministic/index-equivalent selection where specified.
root_design.workloads: Context/row-count matrix then E1/E2; held-out short and wide logits.

experiment.control: The attested baseline with its stock fmaxf contiguous epilogue, independently rebuilt using the same toolchain and launch configurations and equally JIT-warmed. This is the strongest evidenced static comparator; the packet establishes no equivalent flag or stronger drop-in implementation. Keep precision, scheduling, topology, speculation, telemetry and cache preparation identical.
experiment.treatment: Future experiment only: follow attestation, activation, correctness, unprofiled screening, separate mechanism diagnosis, then paired confirmation and held-out evaluation. Change only the coupled three-line epilogue operation. Inspect generated SM90A code for the relevant FMNMX-to-FADD substitution, compensation and unexpected spills or instruction growth. Across every replica/rank, count patched-kernel hits over independently identified eligible contiguous-prefill call opportunities, reporting shapes and score volume; also report eligible calls over all prefill calls. Join requests to final ranks. Use equally warmed JIT artifacts with separately controlled cold KV prefixes and confirmed warm-prefix hits.
experiment.metrics: Primary: native agent-f75 8K/1K prefix workload and fixed-schedule Mooncake anchors adapted to seq64. Record TTFT distributions/tails, request TPOT=(last-first token time)/(server output tokens-1), exact tokens, throughput, qualified request goodput and replay lag. Record cached/uncached prompt tokens, KV blocks, preemption and all-rank draft/verify/accepted counter deltas, resets and missing coverage. Separately measure shape-specific kernel duration and exposed prefill time; exclude profiled runs from the serving frontier. Confirm small gains with at least five alternating paired full-run blocks, baseline-drift checks and paired uncertainty intervals; requests are not independent experimental units.
experiment.supports_if: Active-artifact and numerical gates pass; eligible calls show the intended instruction change and reduced exposed prefill time; paired unprofiled primary runs show an improvement exceeding a predeclared practical threshold with uncertainty excluding no improvement, while quality and tail/TPOT guardrails pass. The effect follows eligible uncached work and weakens where verified cache hits remove it. A benefit confined to long-context diagnostics supports only that narrower applicability.
experiment.rejects_if: Adequate primary-workload coverage establishes that the changed kernel is unused or already equivalent; a supported-domain correctness failure has no acceptable remedy; or sufficiently precise paired results exclude the predeclared useful gain or show unacceptable quality, TTFT-tail, TPOT or goodput regressions. A microbenchmark win without primary serving value rejects promotion for this baseline.
experiment.inconclusive_if: Active include/JIT provenance, numerical domain or dispatch cannot be established; zero hits lack adequate opportunity coverage; telemetry is missing; cache state or arrivals are unmatched; drift or intervals cannot resolve the useful-effect threshold; or only source-author microbenchmarks and profiled measurements are available. Unknown gates remain deferred, not qualified.
experiment.held_out_condition: Reserve distinct long-context lengths, ragged chunk boundaries, mixed prefill/decode arrivals and cold/warm prefix conditions without tuning on them. Keep the cache-isolated 1K/1K diagnostic separate from native anchors. Include paged-only execution as a negative control and verify actual residual contiguous work in warm-cache cases. Seq128 remains a separate configuration arm.
experiment.correctness: Compare stock and treatment against an appropriate higher-precision reference, preserving masks, scale semantics and output dtype. Establish bounds for accumulators, weighted products, reductions and scale halving, including rounding and flush-to-zero behavior. Analytical objection, not an observed failure: finite positive FLT_MAX overflows when doubled; with unit weight and original scale 0.5, the original scalar contribution is finite while delayed compensation cannot recover it. Test extreme finite values, subnormal scales, signed zero, NaN and infinities, plus real-input distributions. Require downstream top-k-set agreement and ordering under the deployed tie policy, including near ties. Author-reported self-consistency is insufficient. Exercise applicable graph/eager, chunking, cache-hit/miss and distributed paths; run a quality subset because arithmetic changes. Map relevant G01–G05 once their definitions are available. Speculative acceptance is diagnostic, not a correctness score.
experiment.cost: Cheap first step: source/configuration/JIT-provenance inspection, followed only if warranted by a small isolated header port. Compilation, correctness and later GPU experiment costs are unknown; none were incurred here. With full eight-GPU node price P8 per hour, report cost per qualified output token as P8 × elapsed_seconds / (3600 × qualified_output_tokens). Keep P8 unset; do not transfer B200 pricing.

root_design.title: Contiguous prefill MQA epilogue
root_design.source_observation: Installed SM90 contiguous header still uses fmaxf and uncompensated scales. DeepGEMM #452 reports H200 kernel gains, with a best-of-three timing caveat and an overbroad numerical exactness claim.
root_design.source_fix: Replace ReLU arithmetic with x+abs(x) and halve downstream scale factors in the contiguous kernel.
root_design.root_prediction: Fewer epilogue instructions may help exposed prefill scoring. Intermediate overflow/underflow and rounding require a defensible domain or a stock fallback.
root_design.baseline_check: Resolve include and JIT artifact, actual FP8/BF16 logit API and shape bands; source presence alone does not prove active dispatch. Preserve the saved CPU overflow counterexample.
root_design.strongest_comparator: Equally compiled/warmed unchanged contiguous kernel; paged decode is a negative control, not an expected gain.
root_design.activation: Changed contiguous calls / independently identified eligible prefill calls, by shape/dtype and cache-hit regime.
root_design.mechanism_diagnostic: Epilogue and total kernel time, prefill span and TTFT; separate cold JIT, prefix reuse and hidden overlap.
root_design.reject_or_defer_if: No enforceable numerical bounds, selected-token/quality mismatch, inactive contiguous path, or component gain without qualifying service improvement.
root_design.correctness: Finite extremes, NaN/Inf, signed zero, subnormals/FTZ, scale halving, reduction bounds, logits/top-k and generation quality.
root_design.workloads: Cold/warm prefill and mixed E1/E2, held-out lengths/dtypes; paged decode negative control.

reasons: h200_applicability_and_correctness_required: The matching SM90 header and author-reported H200 tests support a plausible narrow port. However, active artifact provenance and a sufficient numerical-domain invariant remain unknown. The author's "bit-exact numerics" assertion is not generally valid: intermediate doubling can overflow, scale halving can underflow, and exceptional-value behavior differs. The proposal correctly acknowledges these issues and specifies reference, top-k, graph/cache, distributed and quality checks, but their outcomes and applicable G01–G05 definitions are unavailable.
